entities.name: Slavomir Miletić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Slavomir Miletić was a Serbian sculptor, who lived in the Netherlands. He attended the Académie des Beaux-Arts de l'Institut de France. He was noted for his sometimes large works, characterized by a rough style, and for occasionally provoking controversy.
